The Man Who Turned Himself Into a Walking Billboard

Meet Billy Gibby, the struggling individual who transformed his own body into a brilliant, legal advertising canvas! 🤯 By tattooing company logos directly onto his skin, he ingeniously bypassed expensive marketing permits and taxes, becoming the ultimate walking billboard and a master of unconventional branding. Could you ever imagine monetizing your skin like this? #UnconventionalBranding
